newsitem.title: IRAN: Quake jolts southwest Iran, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake jolts southwest Iran, no damage reported.

text.p: A moderately strong earthquake jolted southwestern Iran on Monday but there were no immediate reports of damage or casualties, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.
It said the quake measuring 4.2 on the Richter scale hit Abdanan, a town with a population of around 55,000 in Ilam province on the Iraqi border, at 5.48 a.m. (0118 GMT).
There had been "no report on casualties or losses", the agency said.
Force four earthquakes are powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
Earthquakes often hit Iran. Earlier this month, a force 7.1 quake devastated nearly 170 villages in the east of the country, killing at least 1,568 people and leaving 50,000 homeless.
